name: What kind of paint is best for kitchen cabinets and trim?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for kitchen cabinets and trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not all paint systems hold up equally in kitchens, where moisture, grease, and frequent cleaning are common. The best results usually come from a durable primer, a hard-wearing topcoat, and a surface prep process designed for cabinets and trim, not just walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use products made for high-wear surfaces, not standard wall paint. The best finish is usually built from proper prep, primer, and durable topcoats.
